title: Finding Summary Counts
description: The shared count-of-findings shape, referenced by any report or persisted artifact that groups findings by severity plus resolved/new/ack. `open` breaks down by severity; `resolved`/`new`/`ack` are counts over separate status buckets. Extracted so review-finding-report.schema.json and review-artifact.schema.json share one definition instead of two copies. Value shape only; the exact status-set membership rule (which findings count where) is owned by review-report-standards for the reviewer-emitted path, and by flow-review/scripts/lib/review-aggregates.jq for the persisted-artifact path.
